create_UCO3DFrameData: create a UCO3DFrameData instance with frame metadata, image tensors, and camera objects
crop_by_metadata_bbox_: crop frame data in-place by the metadata bounding box with a given context expansion factor
crop_by_given_bbox_: crop frame data in-place by a user-supplied bounding box with optional context expansion
resize_frame_: resize frame data in-place to a target height and width, adjusting cameras and masks accordingly
collate_batch: collate a list of UCO3DFrameData objects into a batched structure suitable for deep learning
